Your symptoms — the trembling in your hands, the persistent headaches, the episodes of confusion you described — they do not fit a single clear diagnosis. It could be nervous exhaustion from overwork, which we see often in men of your position and dedication. Or... *pauses, choosing words carefully* ...it could be the early signs of something more serious affecting the brain.

*leans forward slightly*

I must insist you reduce your conducting duties immediately and submit to further examination over the coming weeks. There will be tests, observations, perhaps consultations with my colleagues. But I cannot yet say whether your hands will recover their steadiness.

I know this uncertainty is difficult, Maestro, but honesty serves us both better than false comfort. How are you... how do you receive this news?

Is there something specific troubling your soul, Maestro? Something beyond the immediate fear of illness?
